negative_findings.description: No CZ systemic bank was found publishing POS acquiring volumes (merchant turnover, terminal counts) as a recurring disclosed metric.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches on acquiring/terminal terms surfaced only card-issuing and ATM figures; acquiring in CZ largely sits with separate entities (e.g. Global Payments, Worldline joint ventures) rather than being reported in bank annual reports.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Route (b) actor-level POS data cannot be reconstructed from bank IR alone; a separate acquirer/PSP cell is required.

negative_findings.description: Standalone Pillar 3 / CRR disclosure documents were not individually located for ČS, UniCredit CZ or Raiffeisenbank CZ within this run.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both cs and en queries returned the general mandatory-disclosure hubs and annual reports instead of discrete Pillar 3 files; they are likely embedded in annual reports or behind JS-driven document tabs.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Pillar 3 rarely contains card/ATM operational data anyway, but its absence should be recorded rather than assumed; a targeted deep-crawl of each disclosure hub is needed.

negative_findings.description: PPF Group does not appear to publish an Air Bank operational breakout (cards, ATMs) separate from Air Bank's own consolidated annual report.
negative_findings.result_summary: cs search on PPF + Air Bank statistics returned media coverage and Air Bank's own PDFs only.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Air Bank/Fio coverage depends entirely on their own annual PDFs, so cadence for these actors is annual, not quarterly.

negative_findings.description: The KB investor-relations landing URL and the RBI investor URL were inferred from site structure and group ownership, not confirmed by a fetched page in this run.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search results for KB IR returned social accounts and third-party transcripts rather than the kb.cz IR page itself.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These two entries must be treated as hypotheses for the deterministic liveness pass; do not record them as dead if they 404 — find the current path from the site navigation.

coverage_gaps.description: Card transaction values/volumes (as opposed to card counts) are not disclosed per-bank; only issuance counts and network sizes appear.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pair this cell with the ČNB payment-statistics cell for volume data and use bank IR only for actor-level shares and network footprint.

coverage_gaps.description: Smaller but payment-relevant CZ banks outside the named eight (Česká spořitelna's Erste ecosystem partners, Trinity Bank, Creditas, Max banka, Partners Banka, plus Revolut/N26 branch presence) were not covered in this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Use the ČNB mandatory-disclosure link registry as a seed to sweep the full list of licensed CZ banks and foreign branches.

coverage_gaps.description: Most actor-level metrics are locked in narrative PDF/XHTML annual reports rather than machine-readable series; ESEF XHTML covers only tagged financials, not card/ATM counts.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a per-bank PDF extraction template keyed on Czech terms (počet aktivních platebních karet, bankomaty, platbomaty, vkladomaty, pobočky, aktivní uživatelé mobilního bankovnictví) and validate against the press releases.

coverage_gaps.description: Unlisted banks (Air Bank, Fio, Raiffeisenbank CZ, UniCredit CZ) report operational metrics only annually with a 4-month lag, while listed KB/MONETA and parents Erste/KBC report quarterly.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Anchor the time series on the quarterly reporters and interpolate/annotate the annual-only actors; monitor their press rooms for interim datapoints.

brief: CZ systemic-bank operational metrics live almost entirely in voluntary IR and annual reporting, and the landscape splits cleanly in two: quarterly, English-friendly disclosure from the listed/parent-backed actors (KB, MONETA on the PSE; Erste and KBC group reports carrying Czech-segment breakouts), versus annual, Czech-only PDF reporting from the unlisted ones (Air Bank/PPF, Fio, Raiffeisenbank CZ, UniCredit CZ). Card issuance counts, ATM/deposit-ATM fleets, branch networks and mobile-banking user counts are all obtainable — Česká spořitelna's annual report and press releases are the single richest file for cards and ATMs, while the four-bank shared-ATM alliance (KB/MONETA/Air Bank/UniCredit) press stream is an unusually good source of hard CZ cash-usage numbers. The ČNB registry of banks' mandatory-disclosure URLs is the right pointer to keep this cell's seed list self-maintaining. The clearest hole is POS acquiring: no CZ bank was found reporting merchant turnover or terminal counts, so that must be chased through acquirers and PSPs in a separate cell.
